name: com.barcodereport/barcode-lookup
title: Barcode Report
description: Look up products by UPC, EAN, GTIN or ISBN across 500M+ barcodes, or search by name. No key to try.

tools.name: lookup_barcode
tools.description: Find the product for one barcode: UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-13, EAN-8, GTIN-14, ISBN-10 or ISBN-13. Returns the title and, where known, brand, category, description, image, price, identifiers and book details. Uses one lookup from the monthly allowance; free when the code is not found.

barcode.description: The barcode, for example 049000050103. Spaces and dashes are ignored.

tools.name: lookup_barcodes
tools.description: Find the products for up to 100 barcodes in one call. Duplicates are ignored. Uses one lookup per code that is found; codes that are not found are free. The batch must fit in the remaining allowance: if it has more distinct codes than that, nothing is looked up or charged.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products by title, brand or category when you have a name rather than a barcode. Returns barcode, title, brand, category and image for the best matches. Words shorter than 3 letters are ignored. Uses one lookup per call that returns results.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show the account's plan, monthly allowance, lookups used and when usage resets. Free. Without an API key it shows what is left of today's keyless trial.
